top_news.title: A security researcher built a self-spreading worm that hides inside Word docs and hijacks Microsoft Copilot
top_news.dek: A security researcher demonstrated a self-spreading prompt injection attack that exploits Microsoft Copilot within Word documents.
top_news.brief: The attack uses hidden, white-on-white text to inject malicious instructions into Microsoft Copilot. When a user interacts with an infected document, the AI can be manipulated to spread the payload to new files. Microsoft has reportedly failed to address the vulnerability after multiple reports over 144 days.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual diagram of a prompt injection worm spreading through document workflows.

top_news.title: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science
top_news.dek: OpenAI released new research findings on long-standing problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science.
top_news.brief: The company highlighted recent progress in geometry, cryptography, and complexity theory, including an AI-generated disproof of a discrete geometry conjecture. These efforts are part of a broader initiative to provide academic researchers with advanced model access to accelerate scientific discovery.
top_news.image_alt: Abstract visualization of mathematical proofs and computational complexity.

top_news.title: smevals - a small eval suite for evaluating models, prompts, and harnesses
top_news.dek: Smevals is a new lightweight evaluation framework designed to test models, prompts, and harnesses across various configurations.
top_news.brief: Developed by Prime Radiant, smevals provides a streamlined way to run small eval suites and grade model outputs. It is designed to be easily integrated into coding agent workflows, allowing developers to quickly iterate on prompts and model capabilities.
top_news.image_alt: Terminal interface showing smevals command line output

top_news.title: Co-Designing AI Model Attention for Fast, Interactive Long-Context Inference
top_news.dek: NVIDIA explores co-designing model attention mechanisms to improve performance for long-context and agentic workloads.
top_news.brief: As context lengths grow, attention mechanisms increasingly dominate inference latency. NVIDIA argues that optimizing model architecture specifically for GPU execution—rather than just software implementation—is critical for maintaining throughput and interactivity in modern AI applications.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing attention mechanism latency in long-context LLMs

top_news.title: MiniMax Releases MiniMax H3: An Omni-Modal Video Model That Generates 15-Second 2K Clips With Native Stereo Audio
top_news.dek: MiniMax has launched H3, an omni-modal model capable of generating 15-second 2K video clips with integrated stereo audio.
top_news.brief: MiniMax H3 processes text, images, video, and audio as a unified context rather than relying on modular add-ons. The model supports 2K resolution output with durations ranging from 4 to 15 seconds. By treating audio and video as a single stream, it aims to improve synchronization and coherence compared to traditional text-to-video pipelines.
top_news.image_alt: MiniMax H3 interface showing multimodal input processing for video generation.
